prompt_variants.prompt_text: Create a compact two-minute nocturnal alt-R&B song at about 82 BPM in 4/4. Use sparse felt piano, close restrained lead vocal, low sub pressure, soft rain-like noise, and unresolved chord extensions. Keep the verses almost whispered and the chorus clearer but not triumphant. Use the provided lyrics and preserve the feeling of standing at a threshold where return is tender and dangerous. Use non-lexical phonetic vocals only: breath, hums, ah/oh/mm syllables, no intelligible words.
